name: Swap Intent
description: Lock BCH in an offer that anyone can fill by paying the maker a stated amount of one fungible CashToken. The maker can cancel the offer at any time before it is filled. Once the offer is a set number of blocks old, anyone can return it to the maker without a key.

maker.name: Maker
maker.description: Locks BCH in the offer, names the token and amount wanted, and can cancel until the offer is filled.

taker.name: Taker
taker.description: Fills the offer by paying the wanted tokens to the maker and receives the offered BCH.

expirer.name: Expirer
expirer.description: Anyone. Returns an offer that is old enough to the maker. Needs no key and receives nothing.

open.name: Open offer
open.description: Lock $(<offeredSatoshis>) satoshis in an offer asking for $(<wantedAmount>) tokens of one category.

maker.name: Open offer
maker.description: Generate the cancel key, fund the offer and state the wanted token category and amount.

fill.name: Fill offer
fill.description: Pay $(<wantedAmount>) tokens to the maker and take the $(<offeredSatoshis>) offered satoshis.

taker.name: Fill offer
taker.description: Provide the wanted tokens and the locking script that receives the offered satoshis.

cancel.name: Cancel offer
cancel.description: Return the $(<offeredSatoshis>) offered satoshis to the maker, less the cancel fee.

maker.name: Cancel offer
maker.description: Sign with the key generated when the offer was opened.

expire.name: Expire offer
expire.description: Return the $(<offeredSatoshis>) offered satoshis to the maker, less $(<expireFeeSatoshis>), once the offer is $(<expireAfter>) blocks old.

expirer.name: Expire offer
expirer.description: Anyone may do this once the offer is $(<expireAfter>) blocks old. No key is needed.

openTransaction.name: Offer opened
openTransaction.description: $(<offeredSatoshis>) satoshis locked in an offer for $(<wantedAmount>) tokens.

fillTransaction.name: Offer filled
fillTransaction.description: $(<wantedAmount>) tokens paid to the maker for $(<offeredSatoshis>) satoshis.

cancelTransaction.name: Offer cancelled
cancelTransaction.description: The offer was cancelled and its satoshis returned to the maker.

expireTransaction.name: Offer expired
expireTransaction.description: The offer was old enough and its satoshis were returned to the maker without a key.

fillInput.name: Offer
fillInput.description: The open offer being filled. Holds $(<offeredSatoshis>) satoshis and no tokens.

cancelInput.name: Offer
cancelInput.description: The open offer being cancelled. Holds $(<offeredSatoshis>) satoshis and no tokens.

expireInput.name: Offer
expireInput.description: The open offer being expired. Its sequence number carries the relative lock of $(<expireAfter>) blocks.

makerPaymentOutput.name: Payment to maker
makerPaymentOutput.description: $(<wantedAmount>) tokens paid to the maker. Must sit at the same index as the offer input.

takerPayoutOutput.name: Payout to taker
takerPayoutOutput.description: The $(<offeredSatoshis>) offered satoshis, received by the taker.

refundOutput.name: Refund to maker
refundOutput.description: The offered satoshis returned to the maker, less the cancel fee.

expireOutput.name: Return to maker
expireOutput.description: The offered satoshis returned to the maker after the offer expired, less the expire fee.

offerLockingScript.name: Swap offer
offerLockingScript.description: Pays out to anyone who sends the wanted tokens to the maker at the same output index, back to the maker with the maker signature, or back to the maker without a key once it is $(<expireAfter>) blocks old.

scripts.enforceOneInOneOut: OP_TXINPUTCOUNT OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_1 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
scripts.enforceReturnToMaker: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE <makerLockingScript> OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE <offeredSatoshis> <expireFeeSatoshis> OP_SUB OP_GREATERTHANOREQUAL
scripts.offerLockingBytecode: OP_IF fillPath OP_ELSE OP_IF expirePath OP_ELSE cancelPath OP_ENDIF OP_ENDIF

tokenOutputSatoshis.name: Token output satoshis
tokenOutputSatoshis.description: Satoshis carried by the token output paid to the maker. Paid by the taker.

cancelFeeSatoshis.name: Cancel fee
cancelFeeSatoshis.description: Satoshis kept back from the refund to pay the network fee of the cancel transaction.

makerKey.name: Maker key
makerKey.description: Private key generated by the maker when the offer is opened. Only it can cancel the offer.

offeredSatoshis.name: Offered satoshis
offeredSatoshis.description: Satoshis the maker locks in the offer. The taker receives all of them on fill.

wantedCategory.name: Wanted token category
wantedCategory.description: Category of the fungible CashToken the maker wants, in display byte order (as block explorers show it).

wantedAmount.name: Wanted token amount
wantedAmount.description: Smallest amount of the wanted token the maker accepts. Paying more is allowed.

makerLockingScript.name: Maker receiving locking script
makerLockingScript.description: Where the maker receives the wanted tokens on fill and the satoshis on cancel or expire.

expireAfter.name: Expire age
expireAfter.description: Blocks the offer must wait, counted from the block that confirms it, before anyone can return it to the maker.

expireFeeSatoshis.name: Expire fee
expireFeeSatoshis.description: Satoshis kept back from the returned value to pay the network fee of the expire transaction.

takerLockingScript.name: Taker receiving locking script
takerLockingScript.description: Where the taker receives the offered satoshis on fill.
